newsletter_capability_detail: Meltwater has newsletter-adjacent coverage but only names one platform: the global coverage page states they added 'Expanded YouTube monitoring, Substack as a dedicated source' to close visibility gaps. Beyond Substack, newsletters are not a documented media type - the enumerated channel list runs traditional media, online publications (blogs, review sites, forums), TV/radio, podcasts, AI platforms and social. Their 'newsletters' product page is the reverse direction: a tool to build branded internal newsletters from monitoring results, not a source of newsletter intelligence. Searched their coverage page, integrations/API page and newsletter product pages; no beehiiv, Ghost, Mailchimp, Kit or LinkedIn-newsletter coverage and no sponsor/guest data is documented.

evidence.quote: Expanded YouTube monitoring, Substack as a dedicated source, and social coverage of China through Midu
more than 200 million online publications including blogs, review sites and forums
pulls directly from your media monitoring activity, curates the most relevant coverage, and delivers polished, branded briefings
Search and export mentions, access historical and live analytics, manage searches and tags programmatically

likely_buyer_role: Head of Data Partnerships / Product Director for global content coverage

contact_route.note: Contact form only ('Enter your work email to get started'); no named data-partnership contact or email published.

caveats: The claimed gap is only partly true: Substack is already a dedicated source, so a 'you have no newsletter coverage' pitch would be wrong and easy to rebut. The defensible angle is breadth beyond Substack (beehiiv, Ghost, Kit, Mailchimp, LinkedIn newsletters) plus publication-level and sponsor-relationship data, which their docs do not describe - that remainder is unverified, not a confirmed absence, since 200M+ online publications may already scoop up newsletter web archives. Meltwater also resells under licensing agreements, so redistribution terms will dominate any partnership conversation.
